free_tier.limit: Free of charge in all available regions
free_tier.notes: Interactive prompting in AI Studio itself is not billed

notes: Perpetual free tier, not a trial or credits — defined as usage on a project without paid billing ('Active project or free trial' qualification; spend-based limits N/A on free tier). No credit card needed: an API key from AI Studio with a Google account suffices (official page does not state this explicitly, but free tier is the default no-billing state). Gotchas: on the free tier your content/prompts are used to improve Google products (paid tier is not); daily quotas reset at midnight Pacific; limits are per Google Cloud project, not per API key; exact per-model limits were removed from public docs in 2026 and now only visible in the AI Studio dashboard, and Google has been adjusting them (e.g. Pro free-tier RPD reportedly reduced) — verify in-dashboard before relying on specific numbers. 2026-08-15 re-check: free-tier model list expanded (Gemini 3.7 Flash / 3.6 Flash / Gemma 4 / Embedding 2 / Lyria 3 now 'Free of charge' on the Free Tier); official docs still say rate limits 'can be viewed in Google AI Studio' and publish no free-tier RPM/RPD numbers.
